_doc: Weekly publishing-batch manifest. Single source of truth for what the site currently surfaces as 'this week's batch' across the homepage hero, every page's site-wide banner, the library hub, the learn home, and the footer 'what's new' line. Each entry is a publishing event with an overview article (the hub URL the banner points at) plus the per-locale label, headline, and one-sentence blurb that renders into the banner.
_status: v1 — 2026-05-11. Add a new batch on the Sunday-night-to-Monday-morning canonical publish slot. Set 'current_batch' to its key. Run scripts/inject-batch-banner.mjs to push the banner across all pages. Old batches stay in this file for reference but only the current_batch shows.
_consumed_by: scripts/inject-batch-banner.mjs (renders the site-wide banner), homepage 'Latest batch' section (manual link to overview), and future scripts/build-library-recent.mjs may use the batch metadata to badge articles that belong to it.
_cadence: One batch per week, Sun 8pm ET → Mon 9am ET publish window. expires = date + 14 days (banner shows for two weeks; after that, the next batch should already be in place and current_batch flipped). If a week is genuinely quiet, leave the prior batch's entry as current — the cadence is editorial, not robotic.
